proposal.reason: Main functional change is new host one-sided RMA Put/Signal/Wait execution over the CE/DMA path, including CE-side signal/ack memory, wait/write memops, and RMA launch/init/finalize flow. Enqueue also needs review because it adds substantive host-side RMA task creation/validation, >1GB chunking, per-context planner queues, and new plan scheduling/launch integration for eager and graph-capture paths.
